assumptions: Per task: triangular(0.7×P50, 1.3×P80, P50) from the board estimates; tasks without an estimate use a kind default.
Implemented/tested tasks keep 30 % of their estimate for review and acceptance.
Rework probability = measured share of B1/B2 patch tasks that were rejected or needed rework (10 %); a reworked task takes 1.6×.
Dependency-aware: each sample takes the longest open dependency chain, never less than total work / 4 parallel agents.
Serial Unity runner: tests median 7.3 min, build+uidev median 36.6 min (measured).
Owner/Auditor gates add 0.05–1 working day (mode 0.25); BLOCKED tasks add 0.5–5 days (mode 1).
Build/capture rounds wait 0.1–2 days for storage approval while free disk is below the build gate.

rules: PAUSED: an owner HALT is active.
RED: a critical-path task is BLOCKED or NEEDS_REWORK.
AMBER: any BLOCKED task in B2/B3/V, or free disk below the build gate.
